options.name:  logout
options.command: python ~/.local/bin/confirm_dialog.py 'do you want logout' && ($HOME/.config/hypr/scripts/notify 'Logging out' 0; loginctl terminate-session {calculated_var})

options.name:  reboot
options.command: python ~/.local/bin/confirm_dialog.py 'do you want reboot' && ($HOME/.config/hypr/scripts/notify 'Rebooting' 0; sleep 2 && systemctl reboot)

options.name: 󰐥 poweroff
options.command: python ~/.local/bin/confirm_dialog.py 'do you want poweroff' && ($HOME/.config/hypr/scripts/notify 'Powering off' 0; sleep 1 && systemctl poweroff)
